sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.superhero_name) AS blue_eyes_percentage
FROM superhero AS t1
JOIN colour AS t2 ON t1.eye_colour_id = t2.id
WHERE t2.colour = 'Blue'
